decision: Stop bounded remediation; no new Colab run, no new test-set pass, no claimed model repair.
deployment: Do not promote final DPO checkpoint as a reliable teacher; keep it as a measured research outcome. The SFT parent is also not established as reliable. Existing verifier/template safeguards remain necessary.
stopping_reason: Fixed six-dev pilot still shows obvious factual errors and contradictory outputs under both decoding policies. Fewer tokens or EOS do not constitute a semantic repair.
further_work: Task/reason-balanced preferences, broader SFT and dev coverage, shorter checkpoint intervals and monitored/anchored DPO would require a separate new training study; not executed or guaranteed here.
